d: Watch as Firstpost examines the dangerous diplomatic breakdown between Ethiopia and Sudan, as both neighbors expel diplomats and shut down border consulates while accusing each other of fueling their internal wars. Khartoum has filed formal complaints to the United Nations and the African Union, alleging that the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are using Ethiopian territory to launch devastating drone attacks inside Sudan.
